oniapp.title: Oniapp
oniapp.line: One codebase builds an app for each school.
oniapp.role: Full stack: per-school themes, accessibility and automated tests.
features: A single codebase builds a separate app per school, each with its own bundle ID, theme, icon and Moodle
Theme, colors and features (library, notebook, grades, calendar) configured per school
Moodle integration: grades, calendar, notebook and courses right in the app
OTA updates via EAS on every push, in production and staging

oniappAdmin.title: Oniapp Admin
oniappAdmin.line: Dashboard where each school manages content and users.
oniappAdmin.role: Full stack: most screens built from Figma, tables and endpoint integration.
features: Web dashboard where each school manages the app content and users
Fetching and caching with TanStack Query, forms with Zod and React Hook Form
Interface in shadcn/ui and Radix UI, consistent with the product

seja.title: Seja
seja.line: Wellbeing: communities, journal and habit planner.
seja.role: Full stack: journal, hobby planner, notifications and list editing.
features: Photo and audio posts in communities, personal journal and planner
Social login with Google, Apple and Firebase, with JWT and refresh token
Push notifications and content in several languages with i18next
Habit calendar and theme picker with native gestures and animation

sejaAdmin.title: Seja Admin
sejaAdmin.role: Full stack: initial dashboard setup and brand and style adjustments.
features: Dashboard for report moderation and community management
Same technical base as Oniapp Admin, with Base UI and shadcn

praca22.title: Praça 22
praca22.line: Music school website, built from scratch.
praca22.role: On my own, from design to launch.
features: Institutional website with introduction, teachers and instrument catalog
Animations with Framer Motion and accessible components with Radix UI
Contact with an embedded map and a direct WhatsApp link

ritmar.title: Ritmar
ritmar.role: I worked on the front-end development.
features: Each gym with isolated data and settings
Memberships with automatic renewal via Mercado Pago and Asaas
Automated tests and CI on GitHub Actions

minceJoias.title: Mince Joias
minceJoias.line: Jewelry store with catalog, cart and checkout.
minceJoias.role: I worked on the front-end development.
features: Online store with catalog, cart and full checkout
Dashboard where the owner updates products and tracks orders
Responsive layout tested on several screen sizes
